title: Agent Promotion Event
description: Records agent tier transitions (promotions and demotions) with full evidence chain. Written to the immutable ledger for externally auditable provenance.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent whose tier changed

event_type.description: Whether the agent was promoted or demoted

samples_tested.description: Total signals evaluated at time of transition

false_negative_count.description: FN count in the batch that triggered this event

human_approved.description: Whether a human approved this transition

batch_id.description: Correlation ID of the validation batch

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the transition occurred
